integrity: Symbolic identities and direct numerical checks accompany a complete analytical proof. Publication priority is conditional on comparison with any unindexed earlier equivalent global cycle classification.
scientific_limitations: Valid for real parameters 0<b<1; treats only primitive period-two orbits and their linearized spectra. A simple multiplier -1 does not alone prove creation of a primitive four-cycle. Global attractor dynamics and other parameter regions remain untreated.
title: Exact saddle-index transition of the unique two-cycle in a three-dimensional Hénon map
